Policies and support

Contact and support

Last updated: October 8, 2026

Reach Trumbull Systems LLC about a software order, billing question, partnership or website issue.

Email support

Email info@trumbullsystems.com. You can use this address directly without completing a form or signing into a product account.

For product or billing help, include the product name, the email used for the purchase, the order reference if available, and a short description of the issue. Never include a complete card number, security code or password.

Business correspondence

Trumbull Systems LLC
709 Myrtle Street
New Britain, CT 06053
United States

This is our business correspondence address. Please arrange any meeting with us by email first.

Product help

  • Vidket support
  • Blaze Humanizer contact page
  • VividWriter website and support links

If you are unsure which product or seller a charge relates to, send the receipt reference and charge date to our business email. We can help identify the appropriate support channel.

Partnership inquiries

Include a link or demo, a short description of the software, who it is for and what kind of support you are seeking. We welcome inquiries from developers and business partners worldwide.

Privacy and accessibility

For a privacy request, email legal@trumbullsystems.com with the subject “Privacy request”. See our Privacy Policy for more information.

For an accessibility issue, email info@trumbullsystems.com and tell us the page, what you were trying to do and what prevented you from completing it. Include your browser or assistive technology if you wish. You can request information by email if a page is difficult to use.

Legal and policy questions

For legal notices, privacy matters or questions about our policies, contact legal@trumbullsystems.com. General information, product support and routine billing inquiries go to info@trumbullsystems.com.
